These texts explain **why** Synesis is the way it is. They are not step-by-step material (for that, see the [Tutorials](../tutorials/getting-started.qmd)) nor recipes for a task (see the [How-to Guides](../howto/guia_profissionais.qmd)). Choose by the question you have.

## I want to understand what Synesis is

- [**Synesis 101 course (videos)**](curso_synesis_101.qmd): short videos explaining Synesis from scratch (in Portuguese).
- [What Synesis can express](show_case.qmd): a panoramic view of the annotation possibilities.
- [Why structured annotation matters](por_que_estrutura_importa.qmd): rigor, freedom and the future of qualitative knowledge.
- [Why not just do it in Excel?](guia_sincero.qmd): an honest answer about when Synesis makes sense and when it does not.
- [How Synesis came about](como_surgiu.qmd): the research problem that gave rise to the language.
- [The architectural position](posicionamento_arquitetural.qmd): how Synesis balances readability for people and rigor for machines.

## I want to code with method

- [Coding methods in Synesis](exemplos_codificacao.qmd): expressing qualitative coding traditions with templates.
- [AI-assisted coding](codificacao_assistida_IA.qmd): a real case of bibliometric analysis.
  - [Research metrics](codificacao_assistida_IA_metricas.qmd)
  - [Comparison of AI models](codificacao_assistida_IA_comparacao.qmd)

## I want to connect knowledge and AI

- [Knowledge graphs and GraphRAG](knowledge_graphs.qmd): why knowledge graphs transform qualitative research.
- [Vector embeddings and GraphRAG](graphrag_embeddings_vetoriais.qmd): what semantic search adds to retrieval, measured rather than estimated.
  - [How the benchmark was run](benchmark_rrf_metodologia.qmd)

## I want to see Synesis in my field

- [Law](synesis_para_direito.qmd): legal knowledge as auditable institutional heritage.
- [Scripture](synesis_escrituras.qmd): systematic annotation of sacred texts.
- [Participatory socio-environmental diagnosis](dsap.qmd): coding and SWOT analysis in community diagnoses.

## I want to know how the tool works inside

- [Inside the compiler](fluxo_compilacao_interno.qmd): how text becomes structured knowledge, stage by stage.
- [The LSP interface](interface_lsp.qmd): how the compiler comes alive in the editor.
- [Roadmap and ideas](ideas.qmd): proposals for extending the language that are not implemented yet.
